import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic

def semiOrderedPermutation (nums : List Int) : Int :=
  let n := nums.length
  let idx1 := nums.idxOf 1
  let idxn := nums.idxOf (Int.ofNat n)
  if idx1 > idxn then
    idx1 + n - 2
  else
    idx1 + n - 1
